title: 香港市场七倍市盈率：历史上高个位数触底，这次催化剂在哪
speaker: How Hall

segments.en: We talk about what's still missing. I mean, tell us a bit more about investor positioning right now when it comes to Chinese markets.
segments.zh: 我们讨论还缺什么。请再谈谈目前市场参与者在中国市场的仓位情况。

segments.en: I mean, it's kind of it is weak. That's right.
Southbound flows haven't really come back in a big way. You have the national team stepping in, but from time to time.
segments.zh: 南向资金并未大规模回流。国家队不时介入。

segments.en: From time to time, but, you know, what's going to be the catalyst? Well, it has to be, like, so cheap that it cannot be ignored, right?
segments.zh: 不时介入，但催化剂是什么？必须便宜到无法忽视，对吧？

segments.en: So let's say, you know, seven times pay for a Hong Kong market.
segments.zh: 比如，香港市场七倍市盈率。

segments.en: Then historically, normally, you know, when we get to, you know, this, you know, high single digital level, you know, we tend to bottom out.
segments.zh: 历史上，通常当达到高个位数水平时，往往会触底。

segments.en: So I think, you know, a lot can happen. Like so, for example, you know, next year, you know, if we can see policy makers, starting to make a move on the economy, etc., etc.
segments.zh: 所以我认为很多事可能发生。例如明年，如果政策制定者开始对经济采取行动等。

segments.en: And that would change the sentiment as well. But I think right now, you know, because a growth stock, the relative performance of the growth stock has been, like, so extreme.
segments.zh: 那也会改变情绪。但目前，成长股的相对表现非常极端。

segments.en: So it's really crushing down. It's the same momentum trade everywhere this year, right?
segments.zh: 所以它正在大幅下跌。今年各地都是同样的动量交易，对吧？

segments.en: So now, you know, now the momentum trade crushing down, it's just phenomenal.
segments.zh: 现在动量交易大幅下跌，真是惊人。

segments.en: But even so, it has not reached the extreme, right?
segments.zh: 但即便如此，也还没到极端，对吧？

segments.en: So that for us to reposition on growth stocks. So I think right now, you know, people will feel comfortable.
segments.zh: 所以我们要重新配置成长股。我觉得现在人们会感到安心。

segments.en: We've been, you know, recommending value stocks and also high dividend stocks for some time.
segments.zh: 我们推荐价值股和高股息股已有一段时间了。

segments.en: And now it's really paying out, right? So the Chinese banks are making new highs. I mean, this saga and all that.
segments.zh: 现在真的见效了，对吧？中国银行股创新高，我是说这波行情等等。

segments.en: So I think, you know, that trade has not finished just yet.
segments.zh: 所以我认为，这波交易还没结束。

segments.en: So people should continue to hold on to those names until the relative performance of the growth stock really, really tend to the extreme.
segments.zh: 人们应继续持有这些标的，直到成长股的相对表现真正趋于极端。
